nodes.text: Muster stands at too few, same as last season. I need the whole line walked: every sergeant's report, taken in person, bottom of the road to the top. You've done crown work. This is the older kind.
Because paper says 'quiet' and a sergeant's face says which kind of quiet. My grandmother founded the order on the difference.

choices.text: Then I'll go look at faces.

nodes.text: Hale, first waystation out of Dawnmead. Odessa at the long meadow. Brant at the fork. Edda at the top, the *Last Lamp*. Say I sent you and nothing else. They'll know.
It is. That's rather the point of it.
